decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line was launched only in 2023 with several models and its own presentation page, and it fits the firm's modular system offer, so the investment and the visible commitment favour keeping it, with any weak early results put down to the launch phase.

The LED ceiling luminaire line is close to the core portfolio, is publicly presented with several models and is backed by dealer and planning support, so management will persist with it and treat any disappointing results as temporary.
